Card Q&A.q: Can I declare activation of this card's [Main] effect but choose to not process the "by" conditions for the 1st process?

a: If you don't pay 1 cost, the part after "then" in this card's [Main] effect can't give 1 of your level 3 or higher Digimon
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Card Q&A.a: 1 play cost 3 or lower card with [Chuumon] or [Sukamon] in its name or 1 play cost 3 or lower [CS] trait card.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played using this card's [Main] effect?

Effect: [Main] [Once Per Turn] By paying 1 cost, you may play 1 play cost 3 or lower card with [Chuumon] or [Sukamon] in its name or the [CS] trait from your hand without paying the cost. Then, 1 of your level 3 or higher Digimon gains ＜Reboot＞ and ＜Blocker＞ until your opponent's turn ends.
Inherited Effect: ＜Alliance＞ (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Sukamon] in name or w/[CS] trait: Cost 3
